name: IVR
tagline: International representation for inland waterway interests across Europe
hero_kpi_rationale: Organisation à but non lucratif représentant les intérêts du secteur de la navigation intérieure européenne avec 215+ participants au congrès annuel et réseau international couvrant 11 pays européens.

kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the main annual IVR Congress in Frankfurt 2024.
kpis.description: IVR Congress 2024 held May 15-17 in Frankfurt attracted 225 participants from 11 countries, representing the association's international reach and member engagement.

kpis.name_fr: Participation au colloque de prévention des sinistres
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp 2024.
kpis.description: First edition of Loss Prevention Colloquium held November 4, 2024 in Antwerp attracted 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany, covering technical and financial loss prevention aspects.

kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in IVR membership and governance.
kpis.description: IVR maintains pan-European representation with members from 11 different countries, reinforcing its role as a neutral and independent international inland waterway representative body.

kpis.explanation: New technical information sheets and guidelines released to support the inland shipping industry.
kpis.description: Multiple new technical information sheets were issued during 2024 to provide the industry with current and relevant information on maritime standards and regulations, though specific count not disclosed.

kpis.name_fr: Participation aux commissions CESNI et ZKR
kpis.explanation: Active involvement in European standardization and Rhine shipping commissions.
kpis.description: IVR maintains active participation as observer in CESNI (European Committee for standardization in inland navigation) and ZKR (Central Commission for Rhine Navigation) working groups and sessions, including participation on April 11 and October 17, 2024.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the provided documents. IVR's focus is on inland waterway transportation regulation, loss prevention, and industry standards.
evidence: Document focuses exclusively on governance, regulatory participation, and industry conferences
